DEVICE DESCRIPTION Fetal EchoScan is a cloud-based software-only device which uses neural networks to detect suspicious cardiac radiographic findings for further review by trained and qualified physicians. Fetal EchoScan is intended to be used as an adjunct to the interpretation of the second-trimester fetal anatomic ultrasound exam performed between 18 and 24 weeks of gestation, for pregnant women aged 18 or more.
